place: the Flower Corner in the Easter month, when the game is opened
what: Opening the game in April (the Easter month): the title's town is decorated before any save is read, and the egg hunt's builder read the save (eggState) and threw; the error was caught, but the build had stopped halfway: no eggs drawn and no Easter Bunny at the corner until the date changed. Root cause: eggState assumed a loaded save.
found_by: PHOTOGRAPHER (the browser log of the Easter pictures: TypeError at eggState), confirmed by a boot test with a faked April date
fix: eggState answers 'no egg found yet' when no save is loaded; after the save is read, startGame redraws the eggs without the ones this player already found
check: boot in April: before: bunny no, eggs drawn 0, 1 error; after: bunny yes, eggs drawn 24 of 25 (one already found in the test save), 0 errors
